about: The dev catalogue for the emulators: supabase/seed.sql converted once (slugs as ids, variant ids = SKU lowercased, rupees → paise, color_hex → colorHex), plus the shop's settings. firebase/seed/seed.ts loads it; createdAt/updatedAt are set at load time and "@now" is the load time.
